test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Acts was aimed to provide for the extension of the provisions of Part IX of the Constitution relating to the Panchayats to the Scheduled Areas?
solution:
The correct answer is** PESA Act 1996.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PESA Act 1996** ​

 
 
• Tribal communities that reside in **Scheduled Areas **have the legal right to rule themselves according to their own forms of self-government, which is recognized under the PESA Act.
 
• The Scheduled Area is not automatically covered by the legislation, hence the PESA Act was passed on the advice of the** Bhuria Committee Report,** which was submitted in** 1995**.
 
• The **PESA Act **was passed in **December 1996** to allow Tribal Self Rule in the scheduled territories by extending the rules created by the **73rd constitutional amendment **to those areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part IX of the constitution** related to panchayats consists of** articles 243 to 243-O**.
 
• Article 243A: **Gram Sabha**
 
 
• At the village level, a **Gram Sabha **may exercise the authority and carry out the duties that a** state's legislature **may by law designate.
 
 
 
• Article 243B: **Constitution of Panchayats**
 
 
• In conformity with the guidelines in this Part, **Panchayats** at the village, intermediate, and district levels shall be established in each State
 
 
 
• Article 243C: Composition of Panchayats
 
 
• ​The** Legislature of a State **may, by law, establish rules regarding the makeup of Panchayats, provided that, to the greatest extent possible, there shall be uniformity throughout the State in the ratio between the population of a Panchayat's territorial area at any level and the number of seats in such Panchayat to be filled by election.
